simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to פַּלֵּט (H6405) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-m.

simple.summary: פַּלֵּט (pallêṭ) means escape First listed occurrence: Ps 32 7.

definitions.full: H6405. pallet מַּלֵּט noun [masculine] deliverance (si vera lectio, properly Infinitive of foregoing); — פ ׳רָנֵּי Psa 32:7 shouts of deliverance (dubious, see Commentaries); מַּלֶּטלָֿ֑מוֺ עַלאָֿוֶן 56:8 , read מַּלֶּסֿ (Ew Hup and others) for (their) iniquity weigh to them (retribution), or מַּלֶּטֿ אֵין עַלאָֿוֶן Bae.
